profile.name: NTG Nordic Transport Group A/S
profile.summary: NTG Nordic Transport Group A/S, together with its subsidiaries, provides asset-light freight forwarding services through road, rail, air, and ocean in Denmark, Germany, the United States, Sweden, Finland, and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Road & Logistics and Air & Ocean. It offers road freight solutions, including full-loads, part loads, and groupage; special transport; project transport; temperature-controlled freight transport; and temperature-controlled freight transport, high-tech, furniture transport and logistics, automotive, cycling, textiles, sensitive and regulated goods, dangerous goods freight transport, powder, distribution, and express service. The company also provides ocean freight, such as port-to-port/door-to-door, full container load, less-than-container-load, short sea, buyer's consolidation, cross trade, project transport, charter customs clearance, temperature-controlled transport, and dangerous goods; and air freight comprising airport-to-airport/door-to-door, consolidation, direct shipments, temperature-controlled transport, full/part charter, onboard courier, and dangerous goods. In addition, it offers daily departures, day to day, express, and door to door services; project transportation, including RoRo, oversized cargo, break bulk/heavy loads, point to point/cross trade/third party logistics, vessel and project charter, dangerous goods, turnkey transport, and surveillance and reporting services; and project transport consulting services which include vessel load surveying, velles operations, packaging and securing control, export/import document control, customs clearance, heavy lifting and load planning, and reporting services. Further, the company provides furniture logistics; warehouse logistics; 4PL services; and multimodal freight transport services. NTG Nordic Transport Group A/S was founded in 1988 and is based in Hvidovre, Denmark.
profile.summary_fr: NTG Nordic Transport Group A/S, en collaboration avec ses filiales, fournit des services d’expédition de fret légers par route, rail, air et océan au Danemark, en Allemagne, aux États-Unis, en Suède, en Finlande et à l’international. La société opère à travers deux segments, Road & Logistics et Air & Ocean. Il propose des solutions de fret routier, y compris des chargements complets, des charges partielles et des groupages; transport spécial; transport de projet; transport de marchandises à température contrôlée; et transport de marchandises à température contrôlée, haute technologie, transport et logistique de meubles, automobile, cyclisme, textiles, marchandises sensibles et réglementées, transport de marchandises dangereuses, poudre, distribution et service express.
